edges.reason: msg.sender determines whose balance is debited in transfer.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is checked and reduced in transferFrom.
msg.sender authorizes its own allowance entry in approve.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner.
owner state variable is the authorization reference in onlyOwner.
onlyOwner gate controls execution of transferOwnership.
new owner parameter flows into the owner assignment.
owner is emitted and reassigned in transferOwnership.
transfer recipient parameter is used for the credit and zero-address check.
transfer amount parameter drives the debit and burn computation.
balances mapping is read and written throughout transfer.
count state variable decides which branch of transfer executes.
transfer performs the sender balance subtraction.
transfer calls onePercent when the burn branch is taken.
onePercent calls the SafeMath ceil helper.
token amount parameter flows into the onePercent computation.
extras constant is used as the ceil modulo and multiplier in onePercent.
onePercent performs unscaled mul/div arithmetic on the rounded value.
ceil helper executes add/sub/mul/div rounding math on attacker influenced input.
rounded value from ceil feeds the one-percent arithmetic.
transfer reduces the total supply by the burned amount.
_totalSupply is the value being subtracted from.
transfer credits the recipient balance with an addition.
local burn amount computed in transfer is subtracted from the total supply.
local transfer amount is added to the recipient balance.
from parameter selects the balance and allowance entry in transferFrom.
to parameter is the credit destination in transferFrom.
tokens parameter drives debit, allowance and burn logic in transferFrom.
allowed mapping is read and written in transferFrom.
balances mapping is read and written in transferFrom.
count state variable selects the burn branch in transferFrom.
transferFrom calls onePercent in the burn branch.
transferFrom performs the allowance subtraction.
transferFrom also reduces _totalSupply via the burn amount.
transferFrom credits the recipient balance with an addition.
local burn amount in transferFrom participates in the debit arithmetic.
local transfer amount in transferFrom is added to the recipient balance.
spender parameter is the allowance key in approve.
tokens parameter is stored as the new allowance in approve.
allowed mapping is written by approve.
owner address participates in the token ownership model affecting approvals.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowance lookup.
spender parameter indexes the allowance lookup.
allowed mapping is read by allowance.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances lookup in balanceOf.
balances mapping is read by balanceOf.
_totalSupply is scaled and returned by totalSupply.
decimals is the scaling exponent used in totalSupply.
name argument is written to the name state variable in the constructor.
symbol argument is written to the symbol state variable in the constructor.
decimals argument is written to the decimals state variable in the constructor.
initial owner argument sets privileged ownership in the constructor.
constructor assigns the privileged owner address.
constructor mints the initial balance into the balances mapping.
decimals scales the initial minted supply in the constructor.
fallback is the entry point hit by raw calls from any caller.
both transfer and transferFrom share the same burn branch logic gated by count.
